        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\n\n    \n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;&amp; typeof s.url === 'string' &amp;&amp; s.url.trim().length &gt; 0;\n      if (!hasUrl) {\n        // 没有URL的文本来源，需要检查是否是对话摘要或技术转译\n        const category = getCategory(s);\n        if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\n          return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\n        }\n        return true; // 没有URL且不是对话摘要/技术转译的，归类为互联网信息\n      }\n      \n      const urlStr = s.url.trim();\n      const isHttpUrl = urlStr.startsWith('http://') || urlStr.startsWith('https://');\n      const isFileUrl = !isHttpUrl &amp;&amp; (\n        urlStr.startsWith('/uploads/') || \n        urlStr.startsWith('uploads/') ||\n        /\\.(pdf|doc|docx|txt|md|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|ppt|pptx)$/i.test(urlStr)\n      );\n      \n      if (isFileUrl) {\n        return false; // 排除文件\n      }\n      \n      // 排除对话摘要和技术转译（这些应该显示在历史记录中，而不是互联网信息点）\n      const category = getCategory(s);\n      if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\n        return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\n      }\n      \n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\n      return true;\n    });\n    \n    // 将公共知识库文件（type: 'knowledge_base'）转换为知识点格式\n    const publicKnowledgeSources = sources.filter(s =&gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\n    const publicKnowledgeAsPoints: KnowledgePoint[] = publicKnowledgeSources.map(source =&gt; ({\n      id: source.id,\n      tech_point_id: 0,\n);\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 总结对话内容并保存为来源信息\n  const summarizeAndSaveConversation = async (targetPageType?: string, messages?: Array&lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&gt;): Promise&lt;string | null&gt; =&gt; {\n    // 使用传入的消息列表，如果没有则使用状态中的消息\n    const messagesToUse = messages || aiMessages;\n    \n    // 如果没有对话内容，直接返回 null\n    if (messagesToUse.length === 0) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // 如果没有指定pageType，使用project-{projectId}格式\n    const pageType = targetPageType || (projectId ? &#96;project-${projectId}&#96; : undefined);\n\n    setIsSummarizingConversation(true);\n    try {\n      // 构建对话文本\n      const conversationText = messagesToUse.map((msg) =&gt; {\n        const role = msg.sender === 'user' ? '用户' : 'AI助手';\n        return &#96;${role}: ${msg.content}&#96;;\n      }).join('\\n\\n');\n\n      // 如果对话文本太长，先截断（保留前2000字符）\n      const maxLength = 2000;\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &gt; maxLength \n        ? conversationText.substring(0, maxLength) + '\\n\\n...（内容已截断）'\n        : conversationText;\n\n      // 生成总结（简化版本：使用对话内容作为描述，标题为总结）\n      // 如果对话很长，取前100字符作为标题\n      let summaryTitle = '项目资源对话摘要';\n      let summaryDescription = truncatedText;\n\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\n;\n;",

        },
        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 自动保存对话摘要（使用指定的消息列表）\n  const autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async (messages: Array&lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&gt;) =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    \n    // 检查是否有至少一轮完整的问答（至少一条用户消息和一条AI消息）\n    const userMessages = messages.filter(msg =&gt; msg.sender === 'user');\n    const aiResponseMessages = messages.filter(msg =&gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\n    \n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\n    try {\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录（使用数据库ID）\n        try {\n          const idNumber = parseInt(savedConversationSourceId);\n          if (!isNaN(idNumber)) {\n            await api.delete(&#96;/source-information/${idNumber}&#96;);\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 保存新的对话摘要，使用 project-${projectId} 作为 pageType，传入消息列表\n      const savedId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(undefined, messages);\n      \n      if (savedId) {\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(savedId);\n        \n        // 刷新历史记录\n        await loadSources(); // 重新加载来源列表\n        // 更新历史记录列表，但不自动切换视图（避免强制跳回历史记录页面）\n        await checkHistoryRecords(false); // 传入 false 表示不自动切换视图\n        \n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 对话摘要已自动保存:', savedId);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 自动保存对话摘要失败:', error);\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst summarizeAndSaveConversation = async \n\n\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\n      try {\n        const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\n        const summaryPrompt = &#96;请对以下对话进行总结，生成一个简洁的标题（不超过30字）和一段摘要（不超过300字）。用中文回答，格式为：\n标题：[标题]\n摘要：[摘要内容]\n\n对话内容：\n${truncatedText}&#96;;\n\n        const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\n          summaryPrompt,\n          { context: [{ role: 'user', content: summaryPrompt }] },\n          (aiQAConfig &amp;&amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\n          undefined\n        );\n\n        if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data) {\n          const aiResponse = result.data.answer || result.data.result || '';\n          // 解析 AI 响应，提取标题和摘要\n          const titleMatch = aiResponse.match(/标题[：:]\\s*(.+)/);\n          const summaryMatch = aiResponse.match(/摘要[：:]\\s*(.+?)(?:\\n|$)/s);\n          \n          if (titleMatch &amp;&amp; titleMatch[1]) {\n            summaryTitle = titleMatch[1].trim();\n          }\n          if (summaryMatch &amp;&amp; summaryMatch[1]) {\n            summaryDescription = summaryMatch[1].trim();\n            // 如果 AI 生成的摘要太短，补充完整对话内容\n            if (summaryDescription.length &lt; 200) {\n              summaryDescription = &#96;${summaryDescription}\\n\\n完整对话内容：\\n${truncatedText}&#96;;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn('使用 AI 生成总结失败，使用简化版本:', error);\n        // 如果 AI 调用失败，使用简化版本\n        summaryTitle = messagesToUse.length &gt; 0 \n          ? &#96;项目对话摘要（${messagesToUse.length}条消息）&#96;\n          : '项目对话摘要';\n      }\n\n      // 创建来源信息\n      const sourceId = &#96;project_conversation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;\n      const source: Source = {\n        id: sourceId,\n        title: summaryTitle\n      };\n;\n;",

        "contents": "// 创建来源信息\nrouter.post('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const data: CreateSourceInformationDTO = req.body;\n    \n    // 验证必填字段\n    if (!data.source_id || !data.title || !data.type) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: 'source_id、title和type为必填字段'\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 验证type字段\n    if (!['knowledge_base', 'external'].includes(data.type)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: 'type必须是knowledge_base或external'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const sourceInformation = await sourceInformationService.createSourceInformation(data);\n    \n    res.status(201).json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformation,\n      message: '来源信息创建成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('创建来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '创建来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 批量创建来源信息\nrouter.post",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\n\n    \n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;&amp; typeof s.url === 'string' &amp;&amp; s.url.trim().length &gt; 0;\n      if (!hasUrl) {\n        // 没有URL的文本来源，需要检查是否是对话摘要或技术转译\n        const category = getCategory(s);\n        if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\n          return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\n        }\n        return true; // 没有URL且不是对话摘要/技术转译的，归类为互联网信息\n      }\n      \n      const urlStr = s.url.trim();\n      const isHttpUrl = urlStr.startsWith('http://') || urlStr.startsWith('https://');\n      const isFileUrl = !isHttpUrl &amp;&amp; (\n        urlStr.startsWith('/uploads/') || \n        urlStr.startsWith('uploads/') ||\n        /\\.(pdf|doc|docx|txt|md|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|ppt|pptx)$/i.test(urlStr)\n      );\n      \n      if (isFileUrl) {\n        return false; // 排除文件\n      }\n      \n      // 排除对话摘要和技术转译（这些应该显示在历史记录中，而不是互联网信息点）\n      const category = getCategory(s);\n      if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\n        return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\n      }\n      \n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\n      return true;\n    });\n    \n    // 将公共知识库文件（type: 'knowledge_base'）转换为知识点格式\n    const publicKnowledgeSources = sources.filter(s =&gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\n    const publicKnowledgeAsPoints: KnowledgePoint[] = publicKnowledgeSources.map(source =&gt; ({\n      id: source.id,\n      tech_point_id: 0,\n);\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\nconstructor() {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // SQLite 需要逐个执行语句\n      const statements = [\n        &#96;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n          source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')),\n          url TEXT,\n          description TEXT,\n          page_type TEXT,\n          conversation_id TEXT,\n          metadata TEXT,\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n          created_by TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        )&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at)&#96;\n      ];\n      \n      for (const sql of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(sql);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表或索引已存在的错误\n          if (error?.message?.includes('already exists') || \n              error?.message?.includes('duplicate') ||\n              error?.code === 'SQLITE_CONSTRAINT') {\n            console.warn('表或索引可能已存在，继续执行:', error.message);\n            continue;\n          }\n          throw error;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      console.log('来源信息表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('初始化来源信息表失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadConversationDetail = \nasync (\n      conversationId: string,\n      options?: {\n        append?: boolean;\n        before?: string;\n      }\n    ) =&gt; {\n\n        \n        // 从数据库加载该对话的来源信息（仅在非追加模式下加载，避免重复）\n        if (!options?.append) {\n          try {\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载对话来源信息:', conversationId);\n            const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByConversationId(conversationId);\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 对话来源加载结果:', {\n              success: sourceResult.success,\n              count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\n              error: sourceResult.error\n            });\n            \n            const dbSources = sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data ? sourceResult.data : [];\n            const conversationSources = detail.sources || [];\n            \n            // 合并所有来源：现有来源 + 对话来源 + 数据库来源\n            setSources(prev =&gt; {\n              const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n              \n              // 1. 先添加现有的来源（包括页面类型的来源）\n              prev.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 2. 添加对话中的来源\n              conversationSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 3. 添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\n              dbSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n              console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length, {\n                prev: prev.length,\n                conversation: conversationSources.length,\n                db: dbSources.length\n              });\n              return merged;\n            });\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载对话来源信息失败:\", error);\n            // 如果加载失败，至少保留对话中的来源\n    }\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const AddTextModal: React.FC&lt;AddTextModalProps&gt; = \nconst handleSubmit = async \n {\n      if (files.length === 0) {\n        alert(\"请选择文件\");\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      // 上传文件到服务器\n      setIsUploading(true);\n      try {\n        const uploadedFiles = await aiSearchService.uploadFiles(files, pageType);\n        \n        // 将每个上传的文件转换为Source并添加到来源列表\n        uploadedFiles.forEach((uploadedFile) =&gt; {\n          // description字段包含完整的markdown内容，用于传递给Agent\n          // 如果没有markdown内容，则使用文件大小作为描述\n          const description = uploadedFile.markdownContent \n            ? uploadedFile.markdownContent\n            : &#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(uploadedFile.size)}&#96;;\n          \n          onAddTextSource({\n            title: uploadedFile.name,\n            type: \"external\",\n            url: uploadedFile.url,\n            description: description,\n          });\n        });\n        \n        setFiles([]);\n        onClose();\n        // 触发文件列表刷新\n        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('filesUploaded'));\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\n        alert('文件上传失败，请重试');\n      } finally {\n        setIsUploading(false);\n      }\n    } else if (mode === \"search\") {\n      if (!searchQuery.trim()) {\n        alert(\"请输入检索信息\");\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      // 创建检索信息来源，说明需要AI检索补充信息\n      onAddTextSource({\n        title: &#96;检索信息: ${searchQuery.trim().slice(0, 30)}${searchQuery.trim().length &gt; 30 ? \"...\" : \"\"}&#96;,\n        type: \"external\",\n        description: &#96;[检索信息] ${searchQuery.trim()}\\n\\n说明：此来源需要AI检索补充相关信息。&#96;,\n      });\n      \n      setSearchQuery(\"\");\n      onClose();\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const handleSourcesChange = useCallback(async (newSources: Source[]) =&gt; {\n    // 先更新状态\n    setSources(prevSources =&gt; {\n      // 保存新添加的来源信息到数据库\n      (async () =&gt; {\n        try {\n          const previousSourceIds = new Set(prevSources.map(s =&gt; s.id));\n          const newSourceIds = new Set(newSources.map(s =&gt; s.id));\n          \n          // 找出新添加的来源\n          const addedSources = newSources.filter(s =&gt; !previousSourceIds.has(s.id));\n          \n          // 找出被删除的来源\n          const deletedSourceIds = prevSources\n            .filter(s =&gt; !newSourceIds.has(s.id))\n            .map(s =&gt; s.id);\n          \n          // 保存新添加的来源\n          if (addedSources.length &gt; 0) {\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 保存新添加的来源:', addedSources.length, '个', {\n              pageType: config.pageType,\n              conversationId: currentConversation?.id,\n              sources: addedSources.map(s =&gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title }))\n            });\n            \n            if (currentConversation?.id)\n      }\n    }\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\n  const loadPageTypeSources = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID）\n      const pageTypeToLoad = projectId ? &#96;${config.pageType}-project-${projectId}&#96; : config.pageType;\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载页面类型来源信息:', pageTypeToLoad);\n      const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByPageType(pageTypeToLoad);\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载结果:', {\n        success: sourceResult.success,\n        count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\n        error: sourceResult.error\n      });\n      \n      if (sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载到的来源:', sourceResult.data.map(s =&gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title })));\n        setSources(prev =&gt; {\n          // 合并现有来源和数据库中的来源，避免重复\n          const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n          // 先添加现有来源\n          prev.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          // 再添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\n          sourceResult.data!.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length);\n          return merged;\n        });\n      } else if (sourceResult.error) {\n        console.warn('[SourceInfo] 加载失败:', sourceResult.error);\n      } else {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 没有找到页面类型的来源信息');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载页面类型来源信息失败:\", error);\n      // 不阻止页面加载，只记录错误\n    }\n  }, [config.pageType, projectId]);\n\n  // 检查 URL 参数中的 sourceId 并自动选中（支持多个 sourceId）\n;",

        "contents": "# 外部来源文本内容作为附加信息传递给 Dify\n\n## 功能说明\n\n当在 SourceSidebar 中勾选外部来源（文本类型）时，文本内容会**仅在第一次对话时**作为附加信息合并到查询中，传递给 Dify API。后续对话中不会再次带入附加信息。\n\n## 实现原理\n\n### 1. 前端处理\n\n- **AddTextModal**: 用户通过\"粘贴已复制的文字\"添加文本来源时，&#96;description&#96; 字段会包含完整的文本内容\n- **DialogueContent**: 发送消息时，会将 &#96;sources&#96; 数组传递到后端\n\n### 2. 后端处理\n\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/SendMessage.usecase.ts&#96;\n\n**buildConversationData 方法**:\n\n1. **判断是否是第一次对话**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   const isFirstMessage = !params.conversation || \n                         !params.conversation.messages || \n                         params.conversation.messages.length === 0;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **仅在第一次对话时提取外部来源文本**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   if (isFirstMessage) {\n     const externalTextSources = effectiveSources.filter((s: any) =&gt; \n       s.type === 'external' &amp;&amp; s.description &amp;&amp; s.description.trim()\n     );\n     // ... 构建附加信息\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **构建附加信息**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   if (externalTextSources.length &gt; 0) {\n     const textContents: string[] = [];\n     externalTextSources.forEach((source: any) =&gt; {\n       if (source.description &amp;&amp; source.description.trim()) {\n         const title = source.title || '附加信息';\n         textContents.push(&#96;【${title}】\\n${source.description.trim()}&#96;);\n       }\n     });\n     \n     additionalContext = '\\n\\n=== 附加信息 ===\\n' + textContents.join('\\n\\n---\\n\\n');\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **合并到查询**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   let finalQuery = params.content;\n   if (additionalContext) {\n     finalQuery = params.content + additionalContext;\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 数据流\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n用户勾选外部来源（文本类型）\n    ↓\nDialogueContent 发送消息（包含 sources）\n    ↓",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst handleFileUpload = async \n\n      if (createdSources.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('[文件上传] 创建的来源信息详情:', createdSources.map(s =&gt; ({\n          id: s.id,\n          source_id: s.source_id,\n          title: s.title,\n          url: s.url,\n          page_type: s.page_type\n        })));\n        \n        // 测试查询：立即查询刚创建的记录\n        const pageType = &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;;\n        for (const createdSource of createdSources) {\n          if (createdSource.source_id) {\n            try {\n              console.log('[文件上传] 测试查询刚创建的记录，source_id:', createdSource.source_id);\n              const testResponse = await api.get(&#96;/source-information/source-id/${createdSource.source_id}&#96;);\n              console.log('[文件上传] 测试查询结果:', testResponse.data);\n              \n              // 也测试用pageType查询\n              const pageTypeResponse = await api.get('/source-information', {\n                params: {\n                  pageType: pageType,\n                  page: 1,\n                  pageSize: 100\n                }\n              });\n              console.log('[文件上传] 测试pageType查询结果:', {\n                pageType,\n                count: pageTypeResponse.data.data?.length || 0,\n                sources: pageTypeResponse.data.data?.map((s: any) =&gt; ({\n                  id: s.id,\n                  source_id: s.source_id,\n                  title: s.title,\n                  url: s.url,\n                  page_type: s.page_type\n                }))\n              });\n            } catch (testError) {\n              console.error('[文件上传] 测试查询失败:', testError);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 等待一小段时间确保数据库已更新，然后重新加载来源列表\n      console.log('[文件上传] 等待300ms后重新加载...');\n      await new Promise(resolve =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 300));\n      await loadSources();\n      console.log('[文件上传] 来源列表已重新加载');\n      \n      // 再次等待并重新加载一次，确保数据同步\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 添加来源信息到项目\n   */\n  async addSourceInformation(projectId: number, sourceInformationId: number, notes?: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO project_source_informations (project_id, source_information_id, notes)\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [projectId, sourceInformationId, notes || null]);\n    return (result as any).changes &gt; 0 || (result as any).lastID !== undefined;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 从项目移除来源信息\n   */\n  async removeSourceInformation(projectId: number, sourceInformationId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

修改已完成。更改如下：

## 修改总结

1. **添加状态变量**：
   - `internetInfoSearchQuery`：存储用户输入的搜索内容
   - `isAddingInternetInfo`：处理添加操作的加载状态

2. **添加处理函数** `handleAddInternetInfo`：
   - 验证输入
   - 创建互联网信息来源（格式与 `AddTextModal` 的搜索模式一致）
   - 保存到数据库
   - 刷新来源列表并关闭弹窗

3. **修改弹窗内容**：
   - 从显示已有的来源列表改为显示搜索输入框
   - 添加说明文字
   - 添加“取消”和“插入”按钮
   - 关闭弹窗时清空输入内容

点击“暂无互联网信息点（点击添加）”时，弹窗显示一个互联网搜索输入框，而不是“项目资源对话摘要”的内容。用户可以输入需要检索的信息，点击“插入”后将创建一个新的互联网信息来源。

|\n|---|---|---|---|\n|**参数**|**类型**|**必填**|**说明**|\n|query|String|是|用户的搜索词。|\n|freshness|String|否|搜索指定时间范围内的网页。&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;可填值：&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;- noLimit，不限（默认）&lt;br&gt;    &lt;br&gt;- &lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;推荐使用“noLimit”。搜索算法会自动进行时间范围的改写，效果更佳。如果指定时间范围，很有可能出现时间范围内没有相关网页的情况，导致找不到搜索结果。|\n|summary|Boolean|否|是否显示文本摘要。&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;可填值：&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;- true，显示&lt;br&gt;         "contents": "// Dify聊天消息代理\nrouter.post('/chat-messages', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Chat Messages Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    console.log('API Key (first 10 chars):', apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...');\n    \n    // 直接使用Dify后端地址（9999端口）\n    const difyBaseUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\n    console.log('Dify base URL:', difyBaseUrl);\n\n    // 清理requestBody，确保只发送Dify需要的字段\n    const { appType: _, ...cleanedBody } = requestBody;\n    \n    console.log('发送给Dify的请求体:', {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs,\n      conversation_id: cleanedBody.conversation_id,\n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    });\n\n    // 正确的Dify API端点\n    const difyApiUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/chat-messages';\n    console.log('请求Dify API URL:', difyApiUrl);\n    \n    // 构建请求体，只在有有效conversation_id时才包含它\n    const requestPayload: any = {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs || {},\n      user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    };\n    \n    // 只在有有效conversation_id时才添加它\n    if (cleanedBody.conversation_id &amp;&amp; cleanedBody.conversation_id.trim() !== '') {\n      requestPayload.conversation_id = cleanedBody.conversation_id;\n    }\n    \n    console.log('最终发送给Dify的请求体:', requestPayload);\n    \n    const difyResponse = await axios.post\n;\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 搜索对话和消息\n * POST /api/chat/search\n */\nrouter.post('/search', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { query, appType, userId, messageType, limit = 20, offset = 0 } = req.body;\n    \n    if (!query || query.trim() === '') {\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n        field: 'query',\n        message: '搜索关键词不能为空',\n        value: query\n      }]));\n    }\n    \n    // 这里可以实现更复杂的搜索逻辑\n    // 目前先返回基础的对话列表\n    const conversations = await ChatMessageService.getUserConversations(\n      userId,\n      appType,\n      limit,\n      offset\n    );\n    \n    // 简单的关键词过滤\n    const filteredConversations = conversations.filter(conv =&gt; \n      conv.session_name?.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())\n    );\n    \n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, filteredConversations, '搜索完成'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('搜索失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '搜索失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\nexport default router;",

        "contents": "# Dify API 接口文档\n\n## 概述\n\n本文档描述了与Dify平台集成的API接口，包括AI搜索和技术应用相关的接口。\n\n## 基础信息\n\n- **基础URL**: &#96;http://localhost:3001&#96;\n- **内容类型**: &#96;application/json&#96;\n- **认证方式**: 通过环境变量配置的API密钥\n\n## 接口列表\n\n### 1. AI搜索接口\n\n**端点**: &#96;POST /ai-search&#96;\n\n**描述**: 调用Dify的AI搜索聊天消息API，用于智能问答和搜索功能。\n\n**请求参数**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"query\": \"string (必需) - 搜索查询内容\",\n  \"inputs\": {\n    \"key\": \"value (可选) - 额外的输入参数\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**响应格式**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"data\": {\n    \"event\": \"string - 事件类型\",\n    \"task_id\": \"string - 任务ID\",\n    \"id\": \"string - 消息ID\",\n    \"message_id\": \"string - 消息唯一标识\",\n    \"conversation_id\": \"string - 会话ID\",\n    \"mode\": \"string - 模式\",\n    \"answer\": \"string - AI回答内容\",\n    \"metadata\": {\n      \"usage\": {\n        \"prompt_tokens\": 0,\n        \"completion_tokens\": 0,\n        \"total_tokens\": 0,\n        \"total_price\": \"string - 总价格\",\n        \"currency\": \"string - 货币单位\",\n        \"latency\": 0\n      },\n      \"retriever_resources\": [\n        {\n          \"position\": 1,\n          \"dataset_id\": \"string - 数据集ID\",\n          \"dataset_name\": \"string - 数据集名称\",\n          \"document_id\": \"string - 文档ID\",\n          \"document_name\": \"string - 文档名称\",\n          \"segment_id\": \"string - 片段ID\",\n          \"score\": 0.95,\n          \"content\": \"string - 检索内容\"\n        }\n      ]\n    },\n    \"created_at\": 0\n  },\n  \"message\": \"AI搜索完成\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**示例请求**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:3001/ai-search \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\n    \"query\": \"什么是人工智能？\",\n    \"inputs\": {\n      \"language\": \"zh-CN\"\n    }\n  }'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 技术包装接口\n\n**端点**: &#96;POST /tech-package&#96;\n\n**描述**: 调用技术包装应用，用于技术内容的包装和优化。\n\n**请求参数**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"inputs\": {\n    ",

        "contents": "export class OpenAIProvider implements ILLMProvider {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 发送聊天请求\n   */\n  async chat(messages: ChatMessage[], config: LLMConfig, tools?: Tool[]): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    const url = &#96;${this.apiBaseUrl}/chat/completions&#96;;\n    \n    const requestBody: any = {\n      model: config.model,\n      messages: this.formatMessages(messages),\n      temperature: config.temperature,\n      max_tokens: config.maxTokens,\n    };\n\n    if (config.topP !== undefined) {\n      requestBody.top_p = config.topP;\n    }\n\n    // 添加工具定义（如果提供）\n    if (tools &amp;&amp; tools.length &gt; 0) {\n      requestBody.tools = tools;\n      requestBody.tool_choice = 'auto';\n    }\n\n    let lastError: Error | null = null;\n    \n    // 重试逻辑\n    for (let attempt = 0; attempt &lt; this.maxRetries; attempt++) {\n      try {\n        const response = await axios.post(url, requestBody, {\n          headers: {\n            'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${this.apiKey}&#96;,\n            'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n          },\n          timeout: this.timeout,\n        });\n\n        return this.parseResponse(response.data);\n      } catch (error) {\n        lastError = error as Error;\n        \n        // 如果是网络错误或超时，重试\n        if (this.isRetryableError(error)) {\n          if (attempt &lt; this.maxRetries - 1) {\n            // 指数退避\n            await this.sleep(Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000);\n            continue;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果是客户端错误（4xx），不重试\n        if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {\n          const axiosError = error as AxiosError;\n          if (axiosError.response &amp;&amp; axiosError.response.status &gt;= 400 &amp;&amp; axiosError.response.status &lt; 500) {\n            throw this.handleError(error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    throw this.handleError(lastError || new Error('未知错误'));\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 测试连接\n   */\n  async testConnection(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class DifyGateway {\n\n\n  async executeChat(input: ChatInput): Promise&lt;Result&lt;ChatOutput&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await this.retry(() =&gt;\n        this.chatClient.post('/chat-messages', {\n          query: input.query,\n          conversation_id: input.conversationId,\n          inputs: input.inputs ?? {},\n          response_mode: 'blocking',\n          user: input.userId ?? 'todify-user',\n          files: [],\n        })\n      );\n\n      return success({\n        conversationId: response.data?.conversation_id,\n        messageId: response.data?.message_id,\n        answer: response.data?.answer,\n        raw: response.data,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      const axiosError = error as any;\n      const errorDetails = {\n        message: axiosError.message || (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)),\n        code: axiosError.code,\n        status: axiosError.response?.status,\n        statusText: axiosError.response?.statusText,\n        responseData: axiosError.response?.data,\n        requestUrl: axiosError.config?.url,\n        requestBaseURL: axiosError.config?.baseURL,\n        fullUrl: axiosError.config?.baseURL ? &#96;${axiosError.config.baseURL}${axiosError.config.url}&#96; : axiosError.config?.url,\n        errno: axiosError.errno,\n        syscall: axiosError.syscall,\n        address: axiosError.address,\n        port: axiosError.port,\n      };\n      logger.error('Dify executeChat 失败', { error: errorDetails, input });\n      console.error('Dify executeChat 详细错误:', JSON.stringify(errorDetails, null, 2));\n      \n      // 构建详细的错误消息\n      let errorMessage = errorDetails.message;\n      if (errorDetails.code) {\n        errorMessage += &#96; (${errorDetails.code})&#96;;\n      }\n      if (errorDetails.status) {\n        errorMessage += &#96; [HTTP ${errorDetails.status}]&#96;;\n      }\n      if (errorDetails.responseData) {\n        errorMessage += &#96;: ${JSON.stringify(errorDetails.responseData)}&#96;;\n      }\n      \n      return failure({\n        code: 'DIFY_CHAT_ERROR',\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "### 3. 配置管理\n\n#### 3.1 后端环境变量配置\n创建 &#96;/root/todify2-deploy/backend/.env&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\n# 服务器端口配置\nPORT=3003\n\n# Dify API基础URL\nDIFY_BASE_URL=http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1\nDIFY_WORKFLOW_BASE_URL=http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1\n\n# Dify 应用 API 密钥\nAI_SEARCH_API_KEY=app-t1X4eu8B4eucyO6IfrTbw1t2\nTECH_PACKAGE_API_KEY=app-YDVb91faDHwTqIei4WWSNaTM\nTECH_STRATEGY_API_KEY=app-awRZf7tKfvC73DEVANAGGNr8\nTECH_ARTICLE_API_KEY=app-3TK9U2F3WwFP7vOoq0Ut84KA\nTECH_PUBLISH_API_KEY=app-WcV5IDjuNKbOKIBDPWdb7HF4\n\n# 数据库配置\nSQLITE_DB_PATH=./data/todify3.db\nNODE_ENV=production\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3.2 前端配置\n确保 &#96;frontend/src/services/configService.ts&#96; 中的API URL指向后端代理：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// 所有API URL都应该使用8088端口代理\napiUrl: \"http://47.113.225.93:8088/api/dify/chat-messages\"\napiUrl: \"http://47.113.225.93:8088/api/dify/workflows/run\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3.3 Nginx配置\n创建 &#96;/etc/nginx/sites-available/todify2&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;nginx\nserver {\n    listen 8088;\n    server_name 47.113.225.93;\n\n    # 前端代理到3001端口\n    location / {\n        proxy_pass http://localhost:3001;\n        proxy_set_header Host $host;\n        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n\n        # WebSocket支持\n        proxy_http_version 1.1;\n        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;\n        proxy_set_header Connection \"upgrade\";\n    }\n\n    # API代理到3003端口\n    location /api/ {\n        proxy_pass http://localhost:3003/api/;\n        proxy_set_header Host $host;\n        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. 服务启动\n\n#### 4.1 启动后端服务\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/backend\nnpm run dev &gt; backend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 4.2 构建并启动前端服务\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/frontend\nnpm run build\nnpm run dev &gt; frontend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 4.3 启动Nginx",

        "contents": "// Dify聊天消息代理\nrouter.post('/chat-messages', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Chat Messages Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    console.log('API Key (first 10 chars):', apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...');\n    \n    // 直接使用Dify后端地址（9999端口）\n    const difyBaseUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\n    console.log('Dify base URL:', difyBaseUrl);\n\n    // 清理requestBody，确保只发送Dify需要的字段\n    const { appType: _, ...cleanedBody } = requestBody;\n    \n    console.log('发送给Dify的请求体:', {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs,\n      conversation_id: cleanedBody.conversation_id,\n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    });\n\n    // 正确的Dify API端点\n    const difyApiUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/chat-messages';\n    console.log('请求Dify API URL:', difyApiUrl);\n    \n    // 构建请求体，只在有有效conversation_id时才包含它\n    const requestPayload: any = {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs || {},\n      user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    };\n    \n    // 只在有有效conversation_id时才添加它\n    if (cleanedBody.conversation_id &amp;&amp; cleanedBody.conversation_id.trim() !== '') {\n      requestPayload.conversation_id = cleanedBody.conversation_id;\n    }\n    \n    console.log('最终发送给Dify的请求体:', requestPayload);\n    \n    const difyResponse = await axios.post\n;\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "// Dify工作流代理\nrouter.post('/workflows/run', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Workflow Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    // 直接使用正确的Dify工作流API端点\n    const difyWorkflowUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/workflows/run';\n    console.log('Dify workflow URL:', difyWorkflowUrl);\n\n    const difyResponse = await axios.post(\n      difyWorkflowUrl,\n      { \n        ...requestBody, \n        user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n        response_mode: 'blocking' \n      },\n      {\n        headers: {\n          'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${apiKey}&#96;,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        timeout: 60000,\n      }\n    );\n    \n    console.log('Dify workflow response received:', difyResponse.status);\n    res.json(difyResponse.data);\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('Dify workflow proxy error:', error.message);\n    console.error('Error details:', error.response?.data);\n    res.status(error.response?.status || 500).json({\n      error: error.response?.data || error.message\n    });\n  }\n});\n\nexport default router;",

        "contents": "import type { ApiResponse, ApiErrorPayload } from '@/shared/types/api';\n\nclass ApiClient {\n  private readonly client: AxiosInstance;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.client = axios.create({\n      baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1',\n      timeout: 120_000, // 增加到120秒（2分钟），适应AI请求的较长响应时间\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.request.use((config) =&gt; {\n      const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');\n      if (token) {\n        config.headers = {\n          ...config.headers,\n          Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${token}&#96;,\n        };\n      }\n      return config;\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\n      (response) =&gt; response,\n      (error) =&gt; {\n        // 处理超时错误\n        if (error.code === 'ECONNABORTED' || error.message?.includes('timeout')) {\n          const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n            code: 'TIMEOUT_ERROR',\n            message: '请求超时，请稍后重试。AI处理可能需要较长时间，请耐心等待。',\n            details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n          };\n          return Promise.reject(apiError);\n        }\n\n        const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n          code: error.response?.data?.error?.code || 'API_ERROR',\n          message: error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message || '请求失败',\n          details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n        };\n\n        return Promise.reject(apiError);\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  private unwrap&lt;T&gt;(response: AxiosResponse&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt;): ApiResponse&lt;T&gt; {\n    \n  }",

        "contents": "export class DifyGateway {\n  private readonly chatClient: AxiosInstance;\n  private readonly workflowClient: AxiosInstance;\n  private readonly maxRetries: number;\n\n  constructor(private readonly config: DifyConfig) {\n    if (!config.baseUrl) {\n      throw new Error('Dify baseUrl 未配置');\n    }\n\n    this.chatClient = axios.create({\n      baseURL: config.baseUrl,\n      timeout: config.timeout ?? 30_000,\n      headers: {\n        Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${config.apiKey}&#96;,\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.workflowClient = axios.create({\n      baseURL: config.workflowBaseUrl ?? config.baseUrl,\n      timeout: config.timeout ?? 60_000,\n      headers: {\n        Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${config.apiKey}&#96;,\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.maxRetries = config.maxRetries ?? 2;\n\n    const attachLogging = (instance: AxiosInstance, service: 'chat' | 'workflow')\n;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "## 工作流编排对话型应用 API\n\n对话应用支持会话持久化，可将之前的聊天记录作为上下文进行回答，可适用于聊天/客服 AI 等。\n\n### 基础 URL\n\n### Code\n\nhttp://47.113.225.93:9999/v1\n\nCopyCopied!\n\n### 鉴权\n\nService API 使用 &#96;API-Key&#96; 进行鉴权。 _强烈建议开发者把_ _&#96;API-Key&#96;_ _放在后端存储，而非分享或者放在客户端存储，以免_ _&#96;API-Key&#96;_ _泄露，导致财产损失。_ 所有 API 请求都应在 &#96;Authorization&#96; HTTP Header 中包含您的 &#96;API-Key&#96;，如下所示：\n\n### Code\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;JavaScript\n  Authorization: Bearer {API_KEY}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCopyCopied!\n\n---\n\nPOST/chat-messages\n\n## [发送对话消息](http://47.113.225.93:9999/app/a541096e-d0c1-48f8-98af-df593cf62428/develop#Create-Chat-Message)\n\n创建会话消息。\n\n### Request Body\n\n- Name&#96;query&#96;TypestringDescription\n    \n- 用户输入/提问内容。\n    \n- Name&#96;inputs&#96;TypeobjectDescription\n    \n- 允许传入 App 定义的各变量值。 inputs 参数包含了多组键值对（Key/Value pairs），每组的键对应一个特定变量，每组的值则是该变量的具体值。 如果变量是文件类型，请指定一个包含以下 &#96;files&#96; 中所述键的对象。 默认 &#96;{}&#96;\n    \n- Name&#96;response_mode&#96;TypestringDescription\n    \n    - &#96;streaming&#96; 流式模式（推荐）。基于 SSE（[Server-Sent Events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events)）实现类似打字机输出方式的流式返回。\n        \n    - &#96;blocking&#96; 阻塞模式，等待执行完毕后返回结果。（请求若流程较长可能会被中断）。 _由于 Cloudflare 限制，请求会在 100 秒超时无返回后中断。_\n        \n- Name&#96;user&#96;TypestringDescription\n    \n- 用户标识，用于定义终端用户的身份，方便检索、统计。 由开发者定义规则，需保证用户标识在应用内唯一。服务 API 不会共享 WebApp 创建的对话。\n    \n- Name&#96;conversation_id&#96;TypestringDescription\n    ",

        "contents": "class ConfigService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 测试Dify API连接\n   */\n  async testDifyConnection(config: DifyAPIConfig): Promise&lt;DifyAPITestResult&gt; {\n    const startTime = Date.now();\n    \n    try {\n      if (!config.apiUrl || !config.apiKey) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          message: 'API地址和密钥不能为空',\n        };\n      }\n\n      // 使用Dify API的实际端点进行测试\n      const controller = new AbortController();\n      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() =&gt; controller.abort(), 10000);\n      \n      // 构建正确的Dify API测试请求\n      const testUrl = &#96;${config.apiUrl}/chat-messages&#96;;\n      const testPayload = {\n        inputs: {},\n        query: \"Hello, this is a connection test.\",\n        response_mode: \"blocking\",\n        conversation_id: \"\",\n        user: \"test-user\"\n      };\n      \n      const response = await fetch(testUrl, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${config.apiKey}&#96;,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify(testPayload),\n        signal: controller.signal,\n      }).catch((error) =&gt; {\n        console.error('Fetch error:', error);\n        return null;\n      });\n      \n      clearTimeout(timeoutId);\n\n      const responseTime = Date.now() - startTime;\n\n      if (response) {\n        if (response.ok) {\n          return {\n            success: true,\n            message: &#96;连接测试成功 (${responseTime}ms)&#96;,\n            responseTime,\n          };\n        } else {\n          const errorText = await response.text().catch(() =&gt; 'Unknown error');\n          return {\n            success: false,\n            message: &#96;连接测试失败: HTTP ${response.status} - ${errorText} (${responseTime}ms)&#96;,\n            responseTime,\n          };\n        }\n      } else {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          message: &#96;连接测试失败，请检查API地址和密钥 (${responseTime}ms)&#96;,\n          responseTime,\n        };\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      const responseTime = Date.now() - startTime;\n      let errorMessage = '未知错误';\n  }",

        "contents": "import { \n  Settings, \n  Plus, \n  Edit, \n  Trash2, \n  Eye, \n  EyeOff, \n  TestTube, \n  Save, \n  Download, \n  Upload,\n  AlertCircle,\n  CheckCircle,\n  Loader,\n  RefreshCw,\n  Copy,\n  ExternalLink\n} from 'lucide-react';\nimport TopNavigation from '../components/TopNavigation';\nimport './ConfigPage.css';\nimport configService, { \n  DifyAPIConfig, \n  WorkflowStepConfig, \n  ConfigResponse, \n  DifyAPITestResult \n} from '../services/configService';\n\nconst ConfigPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  // 状态管理\n  const [difyConfigs, setDifyConfigs] = useState&lt;DifyAPIConfig[]&gt;([]);\n  const [workflowConfigs, setWorkflowConfigs] = useState&lt;WorkflowStepConfig[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);\n  const [message, setMessage] = useState&lt;{ type: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null&gt;(null);\n  const [showApiKeys, setShowApiKeys] = useState&lt;{ [key: string]: boolean }&gt;({});\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&lt;\"dify\" | \"workflow\"&gt;(\"dify\");\n  const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState&lt;{ [key: string]: DifyAPITestResult }&gt;({});\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadConfigs();\n  }, []);\n\n  // 加载配置数据\n  const loadConfigs = async () =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const [difyConfigs, workflowConfigs] = await Promise.all([\n        configService.getDifyConfigs(),\n        configService.getWorkflowConfigs()\n      ]);\n      \n      setDifyConfigs(difyConfigs);\n      setWorkflowConfigs(workflowConfigs);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载配置失败:', error);\n      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '加载配置失败' });\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 保存所有配置\n  const saveAllConfigs = async () =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 页面工具配置服务\n */\nclass PageToolConfigService {\n  /**\n   * 根据页面类型获取配置\n   */\n  async getByPageType(pageType: string): Promise&lt;PageToolConfigDTO | null&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get&lt;APIResponse&lt;PageToolConfigDTO&gt;&gt;(&#96;/page-tool-configs/${pageType}&#96;);\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        return response.data.data;\n      }\n      return null;\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 404 表示配置不存在，这是正常情况，不需要记录错误\n      if (error?.response?.status === 404) {\n        return null;\n      }\n      // 其他错误才记录日志\n      console.error('获取页面工具配置失败:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有配置\n   */\n  async getAll(): Promise&lt;PageToolConfigDTO[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get&lt;APIResponse&lt;PageToolConfigDTO[]&gt;&gt;('/page-tool-configs');\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        return response.data.data;\n      }\n      return [];\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取所有页面工具配置失败:', error);\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 将数据库配置转换为PageConfig格式\n   */\n  convertToPageConfig(dto: PageToolConfigDTO): PageConfig {\n    return {\n      pageType: dto.pageType,\n      pageTitle: dto.pageTitle,\n      dialogueTitle: dto.dialogueTitle,\n      studioTitle: dto.studioTitle,\n      workflowSelectionKey: dto.workflowSelectionKey,\n      featureLabelMap: dto.featureLabelMap || {},\n      enabledToolIds: dto.enabledToolIds,\n    };\n  }\n}\n\nexport const pageToolConfigService = new PageToolConfigService();",

        "contents": "class ConfigService {\n,\n    },\n  ];\n\n  // 已废弃：以下默认配置常量已删除，配置已迁移到AI角色管理系统\n  // DEFAULT_SMART_WORKFLOW_CONFIGS 和 DEFAULT_INDEPENDENT_PAGE_CONFIGS 已移除\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有Dify API配置\n   */\n  async getDifyConfigs(): Promise&lt;DifyAPIConfig[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      const stored = localStorage.getItem(this.STORAGE_KEYS.DIFY_CONFIGS);\n      let configs: DifyAPIConfig[] = [];\n      \n      if (stored) {\n        configs = JSON.parse(stored);\n        \n        // 强制清理包含云端地址的旧配置，确保使用本地代理\n        const hasInvalidUrl = configs.some((config: any) =&gt; \n          config.apiUrl?.includes('47.113.225.93') || \n          config.apiUrl?.includes(':9999') || \n          config.apiUrl?.includes('8088/api/dify')\n        );\n        if (hasInvalidUrl) {\n          console.log('⚠️ 检测到旧的云端配置，强制更新为本地代理配置');\n          await this.saveDifyConfigs(this.DEFAULT_DIFY_CONFIGS);\n          return this.DEFAULT_DIFY_CONFIGS;\n        }\n        \n        // 检查是否有禁用的默认配置，如果有则强制启用\n        const hasDisabledDefaults = configs.some((config: any) =&gt; \n          config.id?.startsWith('default-') &amp;&amp; !config.enabled\n        );\n        if (hasDisabledDefaults) {\n          console.log('⚠️ 检测到禁用的默认配置，强制启用Dify API');\n          await this.saveDifyConfigs(this.DEFAULT_DIFY_CONFIGS);\n          return this.DEFAULT_DIFY_CONFIGS;\n        }\n        \n        // 检查是否有技术包装配置，如果没有或API Key不正确，强制更新\n        const techPackageConfig = configs.find((config: any) =&gt; config.id === 'default-tech-package');\n        if (!techPackageConfig || techPackageConfig.apiKey !== 'app-YDVb91faDHwTqIei4WWSNaTM') {\n          console.log('技术包装配置需要更新，强制使用默认配置');\n          await this.saveDifyConfigs(this.DEFAULT_DIFY_CONFIGS);\n          return this.DEFAULT_DIFY_CONFIGS;\n        }\n        \n        // 检查是否缺少任何默认配置\n  }",

        "contents": "import axios from 'axios';\nimport { PageConfig } from '../configs/pageConfigs';\n\nconst API_BASE_URL = '/api/v1';\n\nconst api = axios.create({\n  baseURL: API_BASE_URL,\n  timeout: 60000,\n  headers: {\n    'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n  },\n});\n\n// 添加响应拦截器，静默处理 404 错误（配置不存在是正常情况）\napi.interceptors.response.use(\n  (response) =&gt; response,\n  (error) =&gt; {\n    // 对于页面工具配置的 404 错误，静默处理（不抛出错误）\n    if (error?.config?.url?.includes('/page-tool-configs/') &amp;&amp; error?.response?.status === 404) {\n      // 返回一个模拟的成功响应，data 为 null，表示配置不存在（这是正常情况）\n      return Promise.resolve({\n        data: {\n          success: false,\n          data: null,\n          message: '配置不存在',\n        },\n        status: 200, // 返回 200 而不是 404，避免浏览器控制台显示错误\n        statusText: 'OK',\n        headers: error.response?.headers || {},\n        config: error.config,\n      });\n    }\n    // 其他错误正常抛出\n    return Promise.reject(error);\n  }\n);\n\nexport interface PageToolConfigDTO {\n  id: string;\n;\n}",

{\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\n    method: req.method,\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\n    path: req.path,\n    params: req.params,\n    query: req.query,\n    body: req.body,\n  });\n  next();\n});\n\n// 注册路由\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\nrouter.use('/projects', projectsRouter);\nrouter.use('/public-knowledge', publicKnowledgeRouter);\nrouter.use('/tech-packaging', techPackagingRouter);\nrouter.use('/tech-promotion', techPromotionRouter);\nrouter.use('/tech-press', techPressRouter);\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\n\n// 健康检查\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&gt; {\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\n    headers: req.headers,\n    method: req.method,\n    url: req.url,\n  });\n  try {\n    const response = {\n      success: true,\n      message: 'API is running',\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      version: '1.0.0'\n    };\n    res.json(response);\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: 'Health check failed',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 简单测试端点\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&gt; {\n  logger.debug('Test endpoint called');\n  res.json({\n    success: true,\n    message: 'Test endpoint working',\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\n  });\n});\n\n// 404 处理中间件（必须在所有路由之后）\nrouter.use((req, res) =&gt; 修改已完成。总结如下：

## 修改总结

### 1. 后端 API 路由（已完成）
- 创建了 `backend/src/routes/bochaWebSearch.ts` 路由文件
- 实现博查 Web Search API 的调用
- 在 `backend/src/routes/index.ts` 中注册了路由 (`/api/bocha/web-search`)

### 2. 前端 API 服务（已完成）
- 在 `frontend/src/services/api.ts` 中添加了 `bochaAPI` 服务
- 定义了 `BochaWebSearchRequest` 和 `BochaWebSearchResponse` 类型

### 3. 前端 UI 修改（已完成）
- 添加了 tab 切换功能：**检索信息** 和 **Web Search**
- **检索信息 Tab**：保留原有功能（输入检索信息，AI 自动检索补充）
- **Web Search Tab**：
  - 搜索输入框和搜索按钮
  - 显示搜索结果列表（标题、URL、摘要等）
  - 支持多选搜索结果
  - 保存选中的结果为来源信息

### 4. 功能特性
- Web Search 使用博查 AI API 进行全网搜索
- 搜索结果包含网页标题、URL、摘要、网站名称、发布时间等信息
- 支持选择多个搜索结果一次性保存
- 保存的结果会作为来源信息添加到项目中

### 使用说明
1. 点击“暂无互联网信息点（点击添加）”
2. 弹窗中有两个 tab：
   - **检索信息**：输入检索信息，AI 会在对话时自动检索补充
   - **Web Search**：直接搜索并选择网页结果添加到来源
3. 在 Web Search tab 中：
   - 输入搜索关键词
   - 点击“搜索”按钮
   - 选择要保存的结果（可多选）
   - 点击“添加选中结果”保存

### 注意事项
需要在后端环境变量中配置 `BOCHA_API_KEY`：
```env
BOCHA_API_KEY=your_api_key_here
```

功能已实现。可以测试 tab 切换和 Web Search 功能。

        "contents": "// Web Search API\nrouter.post('/web-search', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { query, freshness, summary, count, include, exclude }: BochaWebSearchRequest = req.body;\n\n    // 验证必填参数\n    if (!query || !query.trim()) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'MISSING_PARAMETER',\n          message: '缺少必填参数: query'\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 检查 API Key\n    if (!BOCHA_API_KEY) {\n      console.error('BOCHA_API_KEY 未配置');\n      return res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'CONFIG_ERROR',\n          message: '博查 API Key 未配置，请在环境变量中设置 BOCHA_API_KEY'\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 构建请求体\n    const requestBody: BochaWebSearchRequest = {\n      query: query.trim(),\n      summary: summary !== undefined ? summary : true,\n      count: count &amp;&amp; count &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; count &lt;= 50 ? count : 10,\n    };\n\n    if (freshness) {\n      requestBody.freshness = freshness;\n    }\n    if (include) {\n      requestBody.include = include;\n    }\n    if (exclude) {\n      requestBody.exclude = exclude;\n    }\n\n    // 调用博查 API\n    const response = await axios.post(BOCHA_API_URL, requestBody, {\n      headers: {\n        'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${BOCHA_API_KEY}&#96;,\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n      timeout: 30000, // 30秒超时\n    });\n\n    // 返回结果\n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: response.data.data || response.data,\n      log_id: response.data.log_id\n    });\n\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('博查 Web Search API 调用失败:', error);\n\n    // 处理 axios 错误\n    if (error.response)\n}",

        "contents": "### 3. 配置管理\n\n#### 3.1 后端环境变量配置\n创建 &#96;/root/todify2-deploy/backend/.env&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\n# 服务器端口配置\nPORT=3003\n\n# Dify API基础URL\nDIFY_BASE_URL=http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1\nDIFY_WORKFLOW_BASE_URL=http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1\n\n# Dify 应用 API 密钥\nAI_SEARCH_API_KEY=app-t1X4eu8B4eucyO6IfrTbw1t2\nTECH_PACKAGE_API_KEY=app-YDVb91faDHwTqIei4WWSNaTM\nTECH_STRATEGY_API_KEY=app-awRZf7tKfvC73DEVANAGGNr8\nTECH_ARTICLE_API_KEY=app-3TK9U2F3WwFP7vOoq0Ut84KA\nTECH_PUBLISH_API_KEY=app-WcV5IDjuNKbOKIBDPWdb7HF4\n\n# 数据库配置\nSQLITE_DB_PATH=./data/todify3.db\nNODE_ENV=production\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3.2 前端配置\n确保 &#96;frontend/src/services/configService.ts&#96; 中的API URL指向后端代理：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// 所有API URL都应该使用8088端口代理\napiUrl: \"http://47.113.225.93:8088/api/dify/chat-messages\"\napiUrl: \"http://47.113.225.93:8088/api/dify/workflows/run\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3.3 Nginx配置\n创建 &#96;/etc/nginx/sites-available/todify2&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;nginx\nserver {\n    listen 8088;\n    server_name 47.113.225.93;\n\n    # 前端代理到3001端口\n    location / {\n        proxy_pass http://localhost:3001;\n        proxy_set_header Host $host;\n        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n\n        # WebSocket支持\n        proxy_http_version 1.1;\n        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;\n        proxy_set_header Connection \"upgrade\";\n    }\n\n    # API代理到3003端口\n    location /api/ {\n        proxy_pass http://localhost:3003/api/;\n        proxy_set_header Host $host;\n        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. 服务启动\n\n#### 4.1 启动后端服务\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/backend\nnpm run dev &gt; backend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 4.2 构建并启动前端服务\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd /root/todify2-deploy/frontend\nnpm run build\nnpm run dev &gt; frontend.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 4.3 启动Nginx",

        "contents": "export const bochaAPI = {\n  // 博查 Web Search\n  webSearch: async (request: BochaWebSearchRequest): Promise&lt;BochaWebSearchResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await apiClient.post&lt;BochaWebSearchResponse&gt;(\"/bocha/web-search\", request, {\n        timeout: 30000, // 30秒超时\n      });\n      return {\n        success: response.success,\n        data: response.data?.data || response.data,\n        log_id: response.data?.log_id,\n        error: response.error ? {\n          code: response.error.code || 'UNKNOWN_ERROR',\n          message: response.error.message || '请求失败',\n        } : undefined,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('博查 Web Search API 调用失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'API_ERROR',\n          message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '网络错误，请检查连接后重试',\n        },\n      };\n    }\n  },\n};\n\nconst legacyApi = {\n  async get&lt;T = unknown&gt;(url: string, config?: any) {\n    const data = await apiClient.get&lt;T&gt;(url, config);\n  }\n,\n};",

        "contents": "import type { ApiResponse, ApiErrorPayload } from '@/shared/types/api';\n\nclass ApiClient {\n  private readonly client: AxiosInstance;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.client = axios.create({\n      baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1',\n      timeout: 120_000, // 增加到120秒（2分钟），适应AI请求的较长响应时间\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.request.use((config) =&gt; {\n      const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');\n      if (token) {\n        config.headers = {\n          ...config.headers,\n          Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${token}&#96;,\n        };\n      }\n      return config;\n    });\n\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\n      (response) =&gt; response,\n      (error) =&gt; {\n        // 处理超时错误\n        if (error.code === 'ECONNABORTED' || error.message?.includes('timeout')) {\n          const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n            code: 'TIMEOUT_ERROR',\n            message: '请求超时，请稍后重试。AI处理可能需要较长时间，请耐心等待。',\n            details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n          };\n          return Promise.reject(apiError);\n        }\n\n        const apiError: ApiErrorPayload = {\n          code: error.response?.data?.error?.code || 'API_ERROR',\n          message: error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message || '请求失败',\n          details: error.response?.data?.error?.details || error.response?.data,\n        };\n\n        return Promise.reject(apiError);\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  private unwrap&lt;T&gt;(response: AxiosResponse&lt;ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt;): ApiResponse&lt;T&gt; {\n    \n  }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/workflow/DIFY_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 37
          }
        },
        "contents": "# “技术包装”模块与Dify服务对接方案\n\n## 1. 目标\n\n对接Dify服务，以实现基于智能搜索结果的自动化技术内容生成。\n\n## 2. 核心流程\n\n- **前端**: 用户在“技术包装”界面触发生成操作，可选择不同模板。前端将智能搜索的结果和所选模板作为输入，发送至后端。\n- **后端**:\n    - 接收前端请求，并调用 &#96;DifyClient&#96; 服务。\n    - &#96;DifyClient&#96; 根据应用类型（&#96;TECH_PACKAGE&#96;）获取对应的API密钥。\n    - 调用Dify的 &#96;workflows/run&#96; API，执行预设的“技术包装”工作流。\n    - 将Dify返回的生成结果（&#96;data.outputs.text&#96;）返回给前端。\n- **前端**: 接收并展示由Dify生成的技术包装内容。\n\n## 3. 关键实施步骤\n\n### 步骤一：环境配置\n\n在 &#96;backend/.env&#96; 文件中，确认并配置以下Dify相关的环境变量：\n\n- &#96;DIFY_BASE_URL&#96;: Dify服务的基地址 (当前为 &#96;http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1&#96;)。\n- &#96;DIFY_WORKFLOW_BASE_URL&#96;: Dify工作流服务的地址 (当前为 &#96;http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1&#96;)。\n- &#96;TECH_PACKAGE_API_KEY&#96;: 从Dify平台获取的“技术包装”应用的API密钥。技术包装：app-GgD3uUNDWOFu7DlBgSVkIrIt\n\n### 步骤二：Dify工作流输入与输出确认\n\n- **工作流文件已更新**：工作流文件已变更为 &#96;guide/workflow/AI问答-技术包装2.yml&#96;。\n- **输入变量分析**：根据新的工作流文件，Dify工作流现在期望一个名为 &#96;Additional_information&#96; 的核心输入变量。\n- **数据映射**：前端传递的智能搜索结果 &#96;stepData.smartSearch&#96; 和模板信息 &#96;template&#96; 需要在后端被整合，并作为 &#96;Additional_information&#96; 变量传递给Dify工作流。\n- **输出格式**：工作流的输出是一个结构化的技术分析报告，而非纯文本。后端需要确保能够正确处理此格式，并将其传递给前端进行渲染。\n\n### 步骤三：后端逻辑完善\n\n- &#96;DifyClient.ts&#96; 中的 &#96;techPackage&#96; 和 &#96;runWorkflow&#96; 方法已基本满足需求。\n- 核心工作是确保传递给 &#96;runWorkflow&#96; 的 &#96;inputs&#96; 对象结构与Dify工作流的定义完全匹配。",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "// Dify聊天消息代理\nrouter.post('/chat-messages', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Chat Messages Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    console.log('API Key (first 10 chars):', apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...');\n    \n    // 直接使用Dify后端地址（9999端口）\n    const difyBaseUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\n    console.log('Dify base URL:', difyBaseUrl);\n\n    // 清理requestBody，确保只发送Dify需要的字段\n    const { appType: _, ...cleanedBody } = requestBody;\n    \n    console.log('发送给Dify的请求体:', {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs,\n      conversation_id: cleanedBody.conversation_id,\n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    });\n\n    // 正确的Dify API端点\n    const difyApiUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/chat-messages';\n    console.log('请求Dify API URL:', difyApiUrl);\n    \n    // 构建请求体，只在有有效conversation_id时才包含它\n    const requestPayload: any = {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs || {},\n      user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    };\n    \n    // 只在有有效conversation_id时才添加它\n    if (cleanedBody.conversation_id &amp;&amp; cleanedBody.conversation_id.trim() !== '') {\n      requestPayload.conversation_id = cleanedBody.conversation_id;\n    }\n    \n    console.log('最终发送给Dify的请求体:', requestPayload);\n    \n    const difyResponse = await axios.post\n;\n}",

        "contents": "// Dify工作流代理\nrouter.post('/workflows/run', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Workflow Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    // 直接使用正确的Dify工作流API端点\n    const difyWorkflowUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/workflows/run';\n    console.log('Dify workflow URL:', difyWorkflowUrl);\n\n    const difyResponse = await axios.post(\n      difyWorkflowUrl,\n      { \n        ...requestBody, \n        user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n        response_mode: 'blocking' \n      },\n      {\n        headers: {\n          'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${apiKey}&#96;,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        timeout: 60000,\n      }\n    );\n    \n    console.log('Dify workflow response received:', difyResponse.status);\n    res.json(difyResponse.data);\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('Dify workflow proxy error:', error.message);\n    console.error('Error details:', error.response?.data);\n    res.status(error.response?.status || 500).json({\n      error: error.response?.data || error.message\n    });\n  }\n});\n\nexport default router;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/workflow/Dify 对话 API.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 54
          }
        },
        "contents": "## 工作流编排对话型应用 API\n\n对话应用支持会话持久化，可将之前的聊天记录作为上下文进行回答，可适用于聊天/客服 AI 等。\n\n### 基础 URL\n\n### Code\n\nhttp://47.113.225.93:9999/v1\n\nCopyCopied!\n\n### 鉴权\n\nService API 使用 &#96;API-Key&#96; 进行鉴权。 _强烈建议开发者把_ _&#96;API-Key&#96;_ _放在后端存储，而非分享或者放在客户端存储，以免_ _&#96;API-Key&#96;_ _泄露，导致财产损失。_ 所有 API 请求都应在 &#96;Authorization&#96; HTTP Header 中包含您的 &#96;API-Key&#96;，如下所示：\n\n### Code\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;JavaScript\n  Authorization: Bearer {API_KEY}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCopyCopied!\n\n---\n\nPOST/chat-messages\n\n## [发送对话消息](http://47.113.225.93:9999/app/a541096e-d0c1-48f8-98af-df593cf62428/develop#Create-Chat-Message)\n\n创建会话消息。\n\n### Request Body\n\n- Name&#96;query&#96;TypestringDescription\n    \n- 用户输入/提问内容。\n    \n- Name&#96;inputs&#96;TypeobjectDescription\n    \n- 允许传入 App 定义的各变量值。 inputs 参数包含了多组键值对（Key/Value pairs），每组的键对应一个特定变量，每组的值则是该变量的具体值。 如果变量是文件类型，请指定一个包含以下 &#96;files&#96; 中所述键的对象。 默认 &#96;{}&#96;\n    \n- Name&#96;response_mode&#96;TypestringDescription\n    \n    - &#96;streaming&#96; 流式模式（推荐）。基于 SSE（[Server-Sent Events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events)）实现类似打字机输出方式的流式返回。\n        \n    - &#96;blocking&#96; 阻塞模式，等待执行完毕后返回结果。（请求若流程较长可能会被中断）。 _由于 Cloudflare 限制，请求会在 100 秒超时无返回后中断。_\n        \n- Name&#96;user&#96;TypestringDescription\n    \n- 用户标识，用于定义终端用户的身份，方便检索、统计。 由开发者定义规则，需保证用户标识在应用内唯一。服务 API 不会共享 WebApp 创建的对话。\n    \n- Name&#96;conversation_id&#96;TypestringDescription\n    ",

        "contents": "// 此部分将通过配置文件管理，以实现动态映射\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2.2 API 设计\n\nAPI 遵循 RESTful 风格，核心端点如下：\n\n*   &#96;POST /api/v1/workflows/run&#96;: 异步启动一个工作流任务。\n    *   **Request Body**: &#96;{ \"workflowId\": \"dify-workflow-123\", \"inputs\": { \"query\": \"React Hooks\" } }&#96;\n    *   **Response**: &#96;{ \"taskId\": \"task-abc-456\" }&#96;\n*   &#96;GET /api/v1/tasks/:taskId&#96;: 查询任务状态和结果。\n    *   **Response**: &#96;{ \"taskId\": \"...\", \"status\": \"completed\", \"result\": { ... } }&#96;\n*   &#96;POST /api/v1/documents&#96;: 保存用户修订后的文档。\n*   &#96;GET /api/v1/documents/:docId/export/pdf&#96;: 导出文档为 PDF。\n\n### 2.3 Dify API 集成 (&#96;DifyClient&#96;)\n\n将创建一个 &#96;DifyClient&#96; 类来封装与 Dify API 的所有交互，包括认证、请求构建和响应处理。\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// src/services/difyClient.ts\n\nimport axios from 'axios';\n\nclass DifyClient {\n  private apiKey: string;\n  private baseUrl: string;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.apiKey = process.env.DIFY_API_KEY || '';\n    this.baseUrl = process.env.DIFY_API_URL || '';\n  }\n\n  async runWorkflow(workflowId: string, inputs: Record&lt;string, any&gt;, isStreaming: boolean = false) {\n    const headers = {\n      'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${this.apiKey}&#96;,\n      'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n    };\n\n    const body = {\n      inputs,\n      response_mode: isStreaming ? 'streaming' : 'blocking',\n      user: 'todify-user-1', // 标识用户\n    };\n\n    const response = await axios.post(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/workflows/${workflowId}/run&#96;, body, { headers });\n    return response.data;\n  }\n}\n\nexport default new DifyClient();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 3. 前端设计\n\n前端将使用 React 和 TypeScript 构建一个单页面应用 (SPA)。\n\n### 3.1 组件结构\n\n*   &#96;App.tsx&#96;: 应用根组件，管理路由。\n*   &#96;pages/WorkflowPage.tsx&#96;: 核心工作流页面，包含五个步骤的 UI。\n*   &#96;components/Step1_Search.tsx&#96;: 搜索步骤组件。\n*   &#96;components/Step2_TechnicalPackage.tsx&#96;: 技术包装步骤组件。\n*   &#96;components/Step3_Promotion.tsx&#96;: 推广策略步骤组件。",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "export class DifyGateway {\n  private readonly chatClient: AxiosInstance;\n  private readonly workflowClient: AxiosInstance;\n  private readonly maxRetries: number;\n\n  constructor(private readonly config: DifyConfig) {\n    if (!config.baseUrl) {\n      throw new Error('Dify baseUrl 未配置');\n    }\n\n    this.chatClient = axios.create({\n      baseURL: config.baseUrl,\n      timeout: config.timeout ?? 30_000,\n      headers: {\n        Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${config.apiKey}&#96;,\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.workflowClient = axios.create({\n      baseURL: config.workflowBaseUrl ?? config.baseUrl,\n      timeout: config.timeout ?? 60_000,\n      headers: {\n        Authorization: &#96;Bearer ${config.apiKey}&#96;,\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.maxRetries = config.maxRetries ?? 2;\n\n    const attachLogging = (instance: AxiosInstance, service: 'chat' | 'workflow')\n;\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {

          }

        "contents": "# Dify API 接口文档\n\n## 概述\n\n本文档描述了与Dify平台集成的API接口，包括AI搜索和技术应用相关的接口。\n\n## 基础信息\n\n- **基础URL**: &#96;http://localhost:3001&#96;\n- **内容类型**: &#96;application/json&#96;\n- **认证方式**: 通过环境变量配置的API密钥\n\n## 接口列表\n\n### 1. AI搜索接口\n\n**端点**: &#96;POST /ai-search&#96;\n\n**描述**: 调用Dify的AI搜索聊天消息API，用于智能问答和搜索功能。\n\n**请求参数**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"query\": \"string (必需) - 搜索查询内容\",\n  \"inputs\": {\n    \"key\": \"value (可选) - 额外的输入参数\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**响应格式**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"data\": {\n    \"event\": \"string - 事件类型\",\n    \"task_id\": \"string - 任务ID\",\n    \"id\": \"string - 消息ID\",\n    \"message_id\": \"string - 消息唯一标识\",\n    \"conversation_id\": \"string - 会话ID\",\n    \"mode\": \"string - 模式\",\n    \"answer\": \"string - AI回答内容\",\n    \"metadata\": {\n      \"usage\": {\n        \"prompt_tokens\": 0,\n        \"completion_tokens\": 0,\n        \"total_tokens\": 0,\n        \"total_price\": \"string - 总价格\",\n        \"currency\": \"string - 货币单位\",\n        \"latency\": 0\n      },\n      \"retriever_resources\": [\n        {\n          \"position\": 1,\n          \"dataset_id\": \"string - 数据集ID\",\n          \"dataset_name\": \"string - 数据集名称\",\n          \"document_id\": \"string - 文档ID\",\n          \"document_name\": \"string - 文档名称\",\n          \"segment_id\": \"string - 片段ID\",\n          \"score\": 0.95,\n          \"content\": \"string - 检索内容\"\n        }\n      ]\n    },\n    \"created_at\": 0\n  },\n  \"message\": \"AI搜索完成\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**示例请求**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:3001/ai-search \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\n    \"query\": \"什么是人工智能？\",\n    \"inputs\": {\n      \"language\": \"zh-CN\"\n    }\n  }'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 技术包装接口\n\n**端点**: &#96;POST /tech-package&#96;\n\n**描述**: 调用技术包装应用，用于技术内容的包装和优化。\n\n**请求参数**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"inputs\": {\n    ",

{
  "contents": "import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';\nimport axios from 'axios';\nimport dotenv from 'dotenv';\n\ndotenv.config();\n\nconst router = Router();\n\n// 博查 Web Search API 端点\nconst BOCHA_API_URL = 'https://api.bocha.cn/v1/web-search';\nconst BOCHA_API_KEY = process.env.BOCHA_API_KEY || '';\n\ninterface BochaWebSearchRequest {\n  query: string;\n  freshness?: string;\n  summary?: boolean;\n  count?: number;\n  include?: string;\n  exclude?: string;\n}\n\n// Web Search API\nrouter.post('/web-search', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { query, freshness, summary, count, include, exclude }: BochaWebSearchRequest = req.body;\n\n    // 验证必填参数\n    if (!query || !query.trim()) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'MISSING_PARAMETER',\n          message: '缺少必填参数: query'\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 检查 API Key\n    if (!BOCHA_API_KEY) {\n      console.error('BOCHA_API_KEY 未配置');\n      return res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'CONFIG_ERROR',\n          message: '博查 API Key 未配置，请在环境变量中设置 BOCHA_API_KEY'\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 构建请求体\n    const requestBody: BochaWebSearchRequest = {\n      query: query.trim(),\n      summary: summary !== undefined ? summary : true,\n      count: count &amp;&amp; count &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; count &lt;= 50 ? count : 10,\n    };\n\n    if (freshness) {\n      requestBody.freshness = freshness;\n    }\n    if (include) {\n      requestBody.include = include;\n    }\n    if (exclude) {\n      requestBody.exclude = exclude;\n    }\n\n    // 调用博查 API\n    const response = await axios.post(BOCHA_API_URL, requestBody, {\n      headers: {\n        'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${BOCHA_API_KEY}&#96;,\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n      timeout: 30000, // 30秒超时\n    });\n\n    // 返回结果\n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: response.data.data || response.data,\n      log_id: response.data.log_id\n    });\n\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('博查 Web Search API 调用失败:', error);\n\n    // 处理 axios 错误\n    if (error.response) {\n      // API 返回了错误响应\n      const statusCode = error.response.status || 500;\n      const errorData = error.response.data || {};\n      \n      return res.status(statusCode).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: errorData.code || 'API_ERROR',\n          message: errorData.message || error.message || '博查 API 调用失败',\n          log_id: errorData.log_id\n        }\n      });\n    } else if (error.request) {\n      // 请求已发出但没有收到响应\n      return res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'NETWORK_ERROR',\n          message: '无法连接到博查 API 服务器，请检查网络连接'\n        }\n      });\n    } else {\n      // 其他错误\n      return res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'UNKNOWN_ERROR',\n          message: error.message || '未知错误'\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  }\n});\n\nexport default router;\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 123
}
